title: Adentris vs Twofold: Behavioral Health Documentation Compared
summary: Adentris vs Twofold for behavioral health and SUD: an affordable AI medical scribe versus real-time revenue integrity, ASAM and 42 CFR Part 2 depth, and an appeals and denials module.
body_markdown:
**The short version:** Twofold and Adentris both work in behavioral health documentation, but they solve different halves of the problem. Twofold is an AI medical scribe that generates structured notes from recordings or dictation across behavioral health and other specialties. Adentris is a revenue integrity and documentation compliance layer that reviews the note, however it was written, in real time before the claim is submitted, with SUD-specific rules like ASAM level of care and 42 CFR Part 2 and an appeals and denials module built in. If your problem is note-writing time, Twofold is built for that. If your problem is denials and audit exposure, that is where Adentris focuses.


Because they emphasize different jobs, the honest comparison is less about which is better and more about which problem you are solving right now. Here is the breakdown.


## What Adentris does


Adentris is an AI platform for revenue integrity and documentation compliance built specifically for behavioral health and SUD programs. It works on top of the EHR you already run, connecting through an API or HL7 where one exists (for example Alleva, Pimsy, Kipu, Epic, or Athenahealth) and through a secure web agent where it does not, so there is no migration. It reviews notes in real time and flags the elements that get behavioral health claims denied before the claim is submitted: medical necessity, ASAM level-of-care justification, treatment plan updates, group therapy attendance, service units, signature timing, and 42 CFR Part 2 consent. When something is missing, it drafts the correction for the clinician to accept, and it pairs documentation review with an appeals and denials module. Adentris is not a scribe: it does not write the note, it makes sure the note will get paid. Adentris is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 certified, with 42 CFR Part 2 controls and BAAs in place.


## What Twofold does


Twofold is an AI medical scribe that generates structured clinical notes from live recordings, dictation, typed notes, or uploaded audio, supporting formats like SOAP, DAP, BIRP, and GIRP across behavioral health and other specialties. It is used by therapists, social workers, and counselors, is HIPAA compliant with a signed BAA, and does not train its models on user PHI. For clinicians who want an affordable, flexible scribe that fits their EHR, Twofold is a strong option.

## Where each fits


Twofold is built to generate structured notes fast and affordably across behavioral health and other specialties. Adentris is built for a different job: catching the documentation gaps that get behavioral health and SUD claims denied and fixing them before submission. It flags a missing medical necessity statement, an unjustified ASAM level of care, or a missing 42 CFR Part 2 consent, drafts the correction while the note is open, and supports the appeal if a payer denies. For SUD programs, ASAM and Part 2 depth, real-time pre-submission timing, and running on any EHR through a secure web agent are the practical differences. A clinician can use Twofold to write the note and Adentris to make sure it gets paid.


## Adentris as a Twofold alternative for revenue integrity


If your practice uses Twofold, or is evaluating it, and the gap you feel is not note-writing time but denied claims and audit exposure, that is a different job. Adentris focuses on the payer side: it checks whether the documentation supports the claim, flags the behavioral health and SUD elements that drive denials, drafts the correction before submission, and pairs that with an appeals and denials workflow. It runs on any EHR through an API, HL7, or a secure web agent, so it fits alongside a scribe rather than replacing it. For clinicians who write notes well but still lose claims, it is a natural complement.


## How Adentris helps


For behavioral health and SUD organizations, the biggest revenue leak is documentation, and it is specific: medical necessity that was never shown, missing ASAM justification, a Part 2 consent that was not captured. Adentris reviews every chart in real time inside your existing EHR and flags exactly those gaps before the claim is filed, then drafts the fix, and it pairs that with an appeals and denials module so compliance and revenue integrity live in one place. At Sobrius Health, a multi-site Virginia SUD provider, pre-submission documentation accuracy moved from 73% to 96%. Adentris is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 certified, with 42 CFR Part 2 controls and BAAs in place. ## Frequently asked questions


**What is the difference between Adentris and Twofold?**


Twofold is an AI medical scribe that generates structured notes from recordings or dictation in formats like SOAP, DAP, BIRP, and GIRP across behavioral health and other specialties. Adentris is a revenue integrity and documentation compliance layer that reviews the note in real time before the claim is submitted, drafts corrections, and has SUD-specific rules like ASAM and 42 CFR Part 2 and an appeals module built in. Twofold helps write the note; Adentris makes sure it gets paid.


**Can Adentris and Twofold be used together?**


Yes. They solve different halves of the problem, so a program can use Twofold to generate the note and Adentris to verify the documentation supports the claim and to handle appeals. Adentris reviews the note however it was written, so it fits alongside Twofold.


**Is Adentris a good alternative to Twofold?**


For programs whose problem is denials and audit exposure rather than note-writing time, yes. Adentris focuses on catching and correcting the behavioral health and SUD gaps that drive denials before submission, with ASAM and 42 CFR Part 2 built in and an appeals and denials module, and it runs on any EHR without a migration.


**Which is better for a substance use disorder program?**


For SUD, the claims that get denied usually turn on ASAM level of care, medical necessity, and 42 CFR Part 2, which Adentris is built around with real-time, pre-submission review and drafted corrections. Twofold is strong for affordable, flexible note generation across specialties. Programs that want SUD-specific compliance depth and denials support often lean Adentris.
